title: Moral Letters to Lucilius
subtitle: Seneca on living well, in modern English
intro: Across these letters, Seneca writes to his friend Lucilius as an equal—candid, sometimes sharp, always practical. They are not sermons from a pedestal but notes from someone who struggled with the same distractions, fears, and vanities we still face. Read them slowly. Argue with him. Try what he suggests.
